ggplot-based Prediction Plot for mvr Models

Source: R/gg_plots.R
gg_predplot.Rd

Create a prediction plot from an mvr model using ggplot2.

Usage

gg_predplot(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mvr'
gg_predplot(
  object,
  ncomp = 1:object$ncomp,
  which,
  newdata,
  labels = FALSE,
  type = "p",
  line = TRUE,
  line.col = "grey50",
  line.lty = 2,
  line.lwd = 0.5,
  xlab = "measured",
  ylab = "predicted",
  main = NULL,
  plotly = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

model object.

...

further arguments passed to methods.

ncomp

integer vector. The model sizes to use for prediction.

which

character vector. One or more of "train", "validation" and "test".

newdata

optional data frame for test predictions.

labels

optional labels for points. If TRUE or "names", row names are used; if "numbers", row numbers are used.

type

character. Plot symbol type passed through to geom_point.

line

logical. If TRUE, draw a \(y = x\) reference line.

line.col, line.lty, line.lwd

graphical settings for the reference line.

xlab, ylab

axis labels.

main

optional plot title.

plotly

logical. If TRUE, use plotly output.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

data(yarn)
mod <- plsr(density ~ NIR, ncomp = 6, data = yarn, validation = "CV")
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  gg_predplot(mod, ncomp = 1:2)
}
